items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When did you join Fletcher Henderson's band?

ctx.x: Do you have any idea? Ten dollars? How many?
I got mine. Yeah, I got mine, all right. And then Fletcher Henderson ... was playin' with him ... boy, he had a band, too.
When did you join Fletcher Henderson's band?
